recommendation.description: APPROVE when the assigned task deliverable is complete, evidence-based and fit to proceed. CHANGES_REQUIRED only when the deliverable itself is materially incomplete, unsupported, contradictory, or fails its acceptance criteria. Product defects discovered by the deliverable are not by themselves a reason to request changes.

missing_required_outputs.description: Material outputs required by the original owner role/task that are absent from the delivered report.

deliverable_defects.description: Concrete defects of the deliverable itself. Product defects merely documented by a valid audit/planning deliverable do not belong here.

rationale.description: Explain how the cited primary facts demonstrate this exact obligation or its conditional applicability. A genuine but irrelevant quote is insufficient for SATISFIED; missing support requires UNSATISFIED.

byte_start.description: Optional citation spans v1 offset: zero-based inclusive UTF-8 byte start within normalized start_line..end_line joined by LF without labels. Must accompany byte_end; absent offsets retain exact whole-line citations.

byte_end.description: Optional citation spans v1 offset: zero-based exclusive UTF-8 byte end within the selected normalized line range. Must accompany byte_start and exceed it; both boundaries must be complete UTF-8 characters. Runtime enforces pairing, exact bytes and the unchanged 2048-byte excerpt cap.
